# Apparel Emporium Ltd. (AELBD)

> Apparel Emporium is a leading export-oriented garments buying house and apparel sourcing agency headquartered in Dhaka, Bangladesh. We connect international fashion retailers, wholesalers, and private labels with certified, compliant apparel manufacturing facilities across Bangladesh.

## Core Manufacturing & Sourcing Capabilities
- **Knitwear:** Single jersey, pique, interlock, fleece, french terry t-shirts, polo shirts, hoodies, sweatshirts, tank tops, and joggers.
- **Woven Apparel:** Denim jeans, twill pants, cargo shorts, formal shirts, casual button-downs, and workwear.
- **Sweaters & Outerwear:** Flat-knit sweaters (3GG to 14GG), cardigans, pullovers, windbreakers, puffers, and softshell jackets.
- **Undergarments & Activewear:** Boxer briefs, leggings, sports bras, moisture-wicking gymwear.
- **Quality Assurance:** Full-time merchandising oversight, inline quality inspections, and pre-shipment AQL 2.5 final audits.
- **Compliance Standards:** Partner manufacturing units adhere strictly to international labor, environmental, and quality safety standards with comprehensive third-party audits.

## Commercial Terms & Quotation Policy
- **Customized B2B Quotations:** As an export-oriented garments buying house, Apparel Emporium does not publish fixed price lists or standard retail rates. Unit pricing is calculated strictly on a custom Request for Quote (RFQ) basis, accounting for fabric composition, GSM, yarn selection, tech pack complexities, custom washings, target order volume, and buyer destination country logistics.
- **Minimum Order Quantities (MOQ):** Flexible and tailored to buyer requirements, fabric knitting/weaving minimums, and dye-lot capacities. Adaptable programs available for emerging labels through to high-volume retail programs.
- **Sampling & Production Lead Times:** Proto sampling typically 7–10 days post-tech pack confirmation. Bulk production schedules are customized according to material availability, fabric lab dip approvals, and buyer critical path timelines.
- **Payment Terms:** Irrevocable Letter of Credit (L/C at sight) or T/T wire transfer, structured transparently for global commercial trade.
